name: World Bank Indicators API
rate_limits: No published rate limits; reasonable use expected
notes: Nearly 16,000 development indicators across 200+ countries. Completely free, no authentication required. Covers economic, financial, social, environmental data spanning decades. Key endpoints: /countries, /indicators, /countries/{code}/indicators/{indicator}. Add ?format=json for JSON (defaults to XML). Additional APIs: Data Catalog API, Projects API, Climate Data API. AI-friendly: consistent schema, well-documented indicator codes, supports pagination. Example: https://api.worldbank.org/v2/country/US/indicator/NY.GDP.MKTP.CD?format=json
